title: Playhouse II | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Home: * Gulf Views from the Lookout Tower * 175 yards to Public Beach Access on Hwy 30A* Walk 500 yards to Seaside Town Center* 4 Bikes Included* Walk to Surfing Deer, Bud and Alley
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Home: * Gulf Views from the Lookout Tower * 175 yards to Public Beach Access on Hwy 30A* Walk 500 yards to Seaside Town Center* 4 Bikes Included* Walk to Surfing Deer, Bud and Alley's, Great Southern Cafe, and Other Fine Cuisine * Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef- More Details under Area Attractions * Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service *This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions.**We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs January thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Take a break from the ordinary, and escape to Playhouse II. This spacious and unique 2000 sq ft beach house is in the heart of Seagrove Beach and next to Seaside Town Center! With colorful artwork throughout, and one-of-a-kind items in every room, you'll have as much fun in this home as you will outside of it. Nestled in a tropical, neighborhood setting, you'll enjoy relaxing on the multiple porches and balconies while planning your day over your morning coffee. Step inside the first floor for the eclectic living room, well equipped kitchen, and a guest bedroom with a Full over Full bunkbed. The second floor features the master bedroom with a King bed, and a guest bedroom with 2 Queen beds. Continue up the stairs to the crows nest for views of the Gulf over the tree tops, and a Twin bed, bringing the total number of guests this home sleeps to 11. The outdoor shower is a perfect spot to rinse off after returning from the beach, just a short walk away. Stroll over to Seaside Town Center anytime you want to take in the galleries, fine cuisine, live theater, variety of stores, or coffee shops! This is the entertaining beach vacation you have been looking for, at Playhouse II.The Bed Setup: 1st Floor: Guest Bedroom: Full-over-Full Bunk Bed 2nd floor: Master Bedroom: King Bed Guest Bedroom: 2 Queen Beds 3rd Floor:Guest Bedroom: Twin BedArea Attractions: Seaside is a fantastic destination, most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. Its incredible architecture has helped to make it famous but also its faithful replication of the kind of seaside town that used to be common up and down the coast. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes Seaside famous. There are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here. 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17 mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous, there are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
